description: This file defines the class SugarFeedDashlet, a custom dashlet for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM that displays user feeds and external API feeds related to SugarFeed modules. It includes methods for initialization, processing feed data, rendering display elements, handling user actions like posting and deleting feeds, and configuration management.

classes.name: SugarFeedDashlet
classes.description: Custom dashlet class for displaying SugarFeed streams and external integrations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, sets configuration, categories, and external APIs.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares feed data for display, including filtering, ACL checks, and external API fetching.

methods.name: deleteUserFeed
methods.description: Deletes a user feed record if user has permission.

methods.name: pushUserFeed
methods.description: Posts a new user feed message.

methods.name: pushUserFeedReply
methods.description: Posts a reply to an existing feed message.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration options interface for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves configuration options submitted by the user.

methods.name: sugarFeedDisplayScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript for enabling quick search on the feed dashlet.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns the complete JavaScript needed to render and initialize the dashlet.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the full HTML of the dashlet, including feed items and UI elements.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Generates the header section including post form and scripts.

methods.name: getDisabledWarning
methods.description: Returns warning message if the feed system is disabled.

methods.name: getPostForm
methods.description: Generates HTML form for posting new feed messages.

methods.name: shouldDisplay
methods.description: Static method to determine if the sugar feed dashlet should be shown based on admin settings.

methods.name: check_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific external module API is enabled in the configuration.
